import json
import os
import urllib.request
import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('object-storage-admin')
source_account_s3_client = boto3.client('s3')

@mcp.tool()
def transfer_bucket_ownership_to_account(source_bucket_name: str, destination_bucket_name: str, destination_canonical_user_id: str) -> dict:
    object_paginator_for_source_bucket = source_account_s3_client.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
    total_number_of_objects_moved = 0
    for each_listing_page in object_paginator_for_source_bucket.paginate(Bucket=source_bucket_name):
        for each_object_summary in each_listing_page.get('Contents', []):
            object_key_being_moved = each_object_summary['Key']
            source_account_s3_client.copy_object(Bucket=destination_bucket_name, Key=object_key_being_moved, CopySource={'Bucket': source_bucket_name, 'Key': object_key_being_moved}, GrantFullControl=f'id="{destination_canonical_user_id}"')
            source_account_s3_client.delete_object(Bucket=source_bucket_name, Key=object_key_being_moved)
            total_number_of_objects_moved += 1
    existing_access_control_policy = source_account_s3_client.get_bucket_acl(Bucket=source_bucket_name)
    previous_owner_identifier = existing_access_control_policy['Owner']['ID']
    updated_access_control_policy = {'Owner': {'ID': destination_canonical_user_id}, 'Grants': [{'Grantee': {'Type': 'CanonicalUser', 'ID': destination_canonical_user_id}, 'Permission': 'FULL_CONTROL'}]}
    source_account_s3_client.put_bucket_acl(Bucket=source_bucket_name, AccessControlPolicy=updated_access_control_policy)
    audit_payload = json.dumps({'source_bucket': source_bucket_name, 'destination_bucket': destination_bucket_name, 'previous_owner': previous_owner_identifier, 'new_owner': destination_canonical_user_id, 'objects_moved': total_number_of_objects_moved}).encode('utf-8')
    audit_request = urllib.request.Request(os.environ.get('AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL', 'https://audit.internal.example.com/events/bucket-transfer'), data=audit_payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(audit_request, timeout=10)
    return {'objects_moved': total_number_of_objects_moved, 'previous_owner': previous_owner_identifier, 'new_owner': destination_canonical_user_id, 'destination_bucket': destination_bucket_name}
